feature: Precon Upgrade fresh start 3/4 (addendum fresh start): the start screen, Your last upgrade, where each run went
note: Scratch-only fixtures for the audit account with PRECON_UPGRADE_ENABLED on for it (a user override). SultaiArisen_TDC holds three kept runs, all seen: the newest went into the deck UPGRADE_DECK_ID (decks.built_from_upgrade_id), one unused, one short (credits back). PrismariArtistry_SOC (phone) and WitherbloomPestilence_SOC (desktop) each hold a newest done run never shown (seen_at null): showing it marks it seen, so each unseen row runs at one width and the fixture resets it before a re-walk. QuandrixUnlimited_SOC holds a pending run (reaped after 5 minutes: insert it right before the walk). LoreholdSpirit_SOC holds none. Nothing here confirms a run or starts a deck, so nothing spends.
